item.title: Re: New author need greenlight for idea
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PMs
Sorry for the late reply
Here lies the crit:

+ show block
– hide block

Overall, while I do think this concept has potential, it's falling really flat in terms of the story. There's no narrative, no event, no character that your article revolves around. You need something more than just "This SCP did this thing and this thing and this thing". It needs to be much more detailed. For example, what may have happened if the SCP did come into contact with another SCP at one point? Maybe have a video transcript of the containment breach? Or maybe have an interview with someone who discovered it/provide some solid backstory for it? Maybe provide a log of contact with aliens? Something like that. Just spice up the story. You have a solid Foundation, but you need to build up on it from there. Unfortunately, until you create an acceptable story, I won't be able to Greenlight it. But if you would like me to take a second look, please do reach out!

item.title: Re: New author need greenlight for idea
item.content:encoded:
+ show block
– hide block

Is a physical manifestation of anti-matter.

What does this mean? Anti-matter isn't an energy form… it is physical matter just, you know, anti-matter. Do you mean this is anti-matter that does not dissapate? Because a piece of anti-matter would negatively react to physical matter… for example they have created anti-matter at least a few times at CERN, but it "evaporated" fairly quickly I believe.

This entity is a sentient black fog.

See… this doesn't seem like a "physical manifestation"

It could be potentially useful to the foundation as it seems to interact with other SCPs in a positive way.

How? What ways? Also it positively reacts to ALL SCP anomalies? There's alot of different stuff on the wiki… many of which are just ideas.

Not much is known about anti-matter today which is why I think it would be cool to have an entity made of it to enhance the aspect of mystery.

While this is true, that not much is known… that just means you have to fill in the blanks. This is still fiction. So what does the anti-matter do to the people who have disappeared? What does the anti-matter do to anomalous objects? (I still think saying something has a universal effect on "SCPs" is problematic, because there's no one thing tying all SCPs together such that you could say this would happen every time, etc)

  • So this feels fairly thin, what is the article about? So there's this thing in a meteorite and people are disappearing… and? What happens in the article? Will the foundation merely catalogue this thing and then that's it? Because nowadays you need more narrative for an article to work…

item.title: New author need greenlight for idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch:
1. To classify a new SCP found from a meteorite in Arizona.
2. This SCP is a class Euclid anomaly. It can be potentially harmful to humans but benefit other SCPs.
3. Documents the new SCPs origin and potential tie into other foundation members.
4. Is a physical manifestation of anti-matter.
5. This document also serves as a warning to other foundation members for what dangers lie may occur if humans have extended contact with this entity.

Central Narrative:
Hikers keep disappearing in Sedona Arizona. The foundation finds it is due to an SCP that “hatched” out of a meteorite that crashed down to earth. This entity is intangible and dangerous to humans after extended exposure to it, causing them to “disappear”. It has a limited radius of its effect. This entity is a sentient black fog. It could be potentially useful to the foundation as it seems to interact with other SCPs in a positive way. It also needs to stay contained, as without proper measure, moves sporadically.

Hook/Attention Grabber:
This SCP is unique in the sense that though it is as of now classified as a Euclid entity, with the right research, could potentially become a Thaumiel entity if used to enhance the abilities of other SCPs the foundation finds useful. It also has the potential to be a tie into how anti-matter can affect other SCPs and may further help to understand all SCPs abilities. Not much is known about anti-matter today which is why I think it would be cool to have an entity made of it to enhance the aspect of mystery.

Additional Notes:
I already wrote a rough draft for the SCP article, but I am a new writer, so I must have the idea greenlight before the draft. My main concern is if there is another SCP like this as I have not read every article. I also want to make sure that I leave a lot of information a mystery without being overly vague.
